name: Cara
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Glottolog lists only Blench 2020 subclassification notes and survey material; no grammar/phonology with a stress statement located online

sources.citation: Decker, Ken, Fittokka Gobak, Iris Sacson, Luther Hon & Adedamola Aregbesola. 2021. A Sociolinguistic Profile of the Cara [cfd] Language of Plateau State, Nigeria. Journal of Language Survey Reports 2021-011. Dallas: SIL International. 40 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Appendix D (348-item wordlist) states: 'The transcriptions are preliminary since no in-depth analysis of tones or other phonological or phonetic features was conducted.' Section 3 'Previous research' says only Blench (2012) collected substantial data on the language.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger M. 2020. An Atlas of Nigerian Languages (2020 edition). Cambridge: Kay Williamson Educational Foundation. Entry 70 'Cara'.
sources.note: Nothing; bibliographic entry lists only 'Wordlist: Shimizu (1975c); Blench (2016)' -- no grammar, phonology or dictionary for Cara.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger M. 2020. Research on the Plateau languages of Central Nigeria. Afrika und Übersee 93: 3-44. doi:10.15460/auue.2020.93.1.209.
sources.note: Nothing on Cara prosody; section 2.3 Beromic notes Cara (Teriya) 'was reported in a mimeo paper by Shimizu (1975b)'; Table 2 shows no literacy/scripture/media work in Cara.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger M. 2012. The Cara language of Central Nigeria and its affinities. Ms. (draft circulated for comment, printout 21 July 2012), Kay Williamson Educational Foundation, Cambridge. 31 pp., 616-item annotated wordlist with sections on phonology and noun morphology.
sources.note: Nothing. Section 3 Phonology (pp. 2-3) covers vowels (7, with length contrast), consonants, and 3.3 Tones: 'Cara has three level tones, but no contour tones on single segments.' The words stress/accent do not occur in the document.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger M. 2006. Comparative Beromic. Ms. [draft], Mallam Dendo, Cambridge, 3 January 2006. 25 pp.
sources.note: Nothing; comparative wordlist tables only (Berom, Tahos, Nincut, Cara, Iten, Shall, Zwall), no prose phonology.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger M. 1999. Field trip to record the status of some little-known Nigerian languages. Ogmios 11: 11-14 (section 'Cara').
sources.note: Nothing; location, names, speaker numbers and language-shift remarks only.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger M. (2016 or later revision). Cara wordlist / dictionary, cited as 'Blench (2016)' under entry 70 Cara in An Atlas of Nigerian Languages (2019/2020 eds.).
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: If a revised version of the 2012 manuscript exists with an expanded phonology section it would supersede the 2012 draft; all Internet Archive copy of Cara% through 2025 are the same 2012 file, so this may just be a re-dating.

sources.citation: Shimizu, Kiyoshi. 1975. [Cara (Fâ-chàrà) wordlist / notes], unpublished mimeo, cited as Shimizu (1975b) in Blench 2020 and Shimizu (1975c) in Blench's Atlas; the only pre-Blench language data on Cara.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Only other primary record of the language; might carry transcription notes on tone/stress, though as a lexicostatistical list it probably does not.
